description: This file contains tests for the heartbeat runner module, specifically testing the ghost reminder bug and related event handling logic within a testing environment using Vitest. It includes setup, mocking external dependencies, and various test cases validating system behavior upon different event sequences.

methods.name: createHeartbeatDeps
methods.description: Creates mocked dependencies for sending Telegram messages and getting replies, used in testing various heartbeat scenarios.

methods.name: createConfig
methods.description: Generates a configuration object and session key for test cases, supporting different target modes.

methods.name: expectCronEventPrompt
methods.description: Validates that the system event context contains expected reminder prompt details.

methods.name: runCronReminderCase
methods.description: Convenience function to run a test case involving a cron reminder event.

methods.name: runHeartbeatCase
methods.description: Executes a heartbeat test scenario with specified parameters, setting up sandbox environment, mocking dependencies, and verifying outcomes.
